items.title: ‘It’s like the wild west’: how AI has rocked the literary world
items.excerpt: With authors losing lucrative deals and writers removed from prize shortlists, accusations of AI use are sending shock waves through the publishing industry. Is it too late to turn the tide on machine writing?

items.title: Author Says the Hundreds of Full-Length Romance Novels She Publishes Every Year Are Very High Quality in Spite of AI Usage
items.excerpt: South African "writer" Coral Hart insists that her AI-generated books are solid, because they draw on numerous large language models.

items.title: AI Is Destroying the Trust Between Writers and Readers
items.excerpt: Novelist Rachel Kadish describes ChatGPT inventing a false plotline for her novel The Weight of Ink that a reader then confronted her about, and argues AI literary scams and fabrications are eroding trust between authors and readers.

items.title: SAG-AFTRA chief: up to 15% of members want AI blocked

items.title: SelfPubCon26 highlights: 7 ideas from the 2026 Self-Publishing Advice Conference

items.title: TN suspends five library officials over procurement of AI-generated books

items.title: Libraries of lies: The Tamil Nadu scam involving fake authors, stolen ISBNs, and AI slop
items.excerpt: After writer Perumal Murugan raised concerns about the books at Coimbatore's Periyar Arivulagam, researchers and a public interest technologist have flagged similar discrepancies in other public libraries in Tamil Nadu.

items.title: AI author scams target NZ writers with $150 'invitations'

items.title: Wee Tian Beng's The Celestial Zone Is Getting an AI-Assisted Anime From 2027
